data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, independently of others. Fisher01–24: please each state your exact intended catch and any conditions; 18 is an individual opt-in, not a unanimous deal. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled, but lowers remainder8 and low-recovery stock16. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Long-run gains aren't guaranteed.
